controlled_comparison.important_confound: Automatic fold-local PCA k95 increased from approximately 5-6 in e1p to 8 in all f4 folds. A fixed-k=6 shadow is required before attributing differences purely to context coverage.

decision_rule: If nonlinear log-regret training fit becomes strong but LOCO generalization remains poor, the remaining bottleneck is terrain representation / context-to-response generalization. If training fit remains poor, do not change terrain encoding yet.
interpretation_guard: TRAIN-only controlled coverage experiment. The same 18 original rough contexts are held out one-at-a-time. Each fold trains on flat + low_friction + 17 remaining original rough + 15 frozen full-grid extension rough contexts. No validation/test/hard terrain is used. Physical outcome and scalarization semantics remain frozen.

metadata_repair.reason: f4 source was derived from e1p and stale schema/supervision/comparison labels survived the source transformation.

model.input: [fold-local PCA terrain latent, friction mu, beta simplex lambda]

selector: Predict all 21 original-space regret vectors, construct the predicted Pareto front, and minimize the original augmented weighted Tchebycheff score for w.
supervision: 34 TRAIN contexts x 21 beta points = 714 dense regret-surface samples per fold
target: standardized log1p(frozen T5.5d context-local normalized regret)
target_transform_guard: log1p is used only to condition the regression loss. Predictions are inverse-transformed back to the original frozen regret space before Pareto filtering, mission scalarization, and beta selection.
terrain_encoder: strict fold-local PCA k95 from 32 rough TRAIN patches (17 original + 15 extension)
